data.narrative:
Alto Neuroscience, a public-stage biotech company founded by Amit Etkin, is valued at $1.04B after raising $253M to date. The valuation assessment draws from a peer universe of five same-sector, similar-valuation-tier comparables in Biotech & Health, spanning both public and late-stage private firms.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach here. The five-company peer set—comprising Chai Discovery ($3.8B), New Limit ($3.1B), Recursion Pharmaceuticals ($1.6B), Freenome ($1.1B), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M)—yields a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range spanning $539M to $3.8B. Public-comp anchoring using sector P/S multiples (5.6x median across three public biotech tickers) cannot be applied due to the absence of disclosed revenue figures, typical for private companies. 

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $1.4B to $1.8B, centered at $1.6B. Alto's current $1.04B valuation sits below the peer median, suggesting either a valuation discount relative to comparable-stage peers or potential upside to the median. Key uncertainties include stage-of-development risk relative to the peer cohort mix and the timing of clinical or commercial inflection points. The peer range itself ($539M–$3.8B) reflects meaningful variance in company trajectories within the sector.
